WEBSITE INFORMATION

Privacy

How this Evoxnet informational website handles information.

Browsing this website

This website does not include analytics, advertising trackers, account registration, contact forms, or cookies set by its own code. Fonts, artwork, styles, and scripts are served with the website.

Hosting

The hosting provider may process technical information, such as IP addresses and request logs, to deliver and secure the website. When hosted on GitHub Pages, GitHub’s applicable privacy statement governs that processing.

GitHub privacy statement

Email and external links

If an email link is available, it opens your email application. Your message is only sent when you choose to send it there. External websites and products have their own privacy practices.

Product privacy

This notice applies to the Evoxnet company website. ZestMenu and future products need their own privacy information.

Updates

Review this notice when adding new services or data collection.
